description: Branches (3-2-1 on the fly, docs/plans/P2B-ZWEIGE-ENTWURF.md): which Job record is the branch of which main Job record. The branch is an ordinary Job (own JobId, level, pool, volumes, File and JobMedia records); only this table says that it shares its stream with the main job. Written only by odir when it starts a job with `Branch` (odir.d).
author: Onesimus

tables.name: onesimus.job_branch
tables.description: One branch job of a main job: both are rows of the Job table; the branch has no File Daemon session of its own.

columns.name: main_job_id
columns.description: JobId of the main job whose stream the branch writes
